dataset_info.name: IEEE DataPort - Classification of handwritten and printed text in doctor's prescription
dataset_info.leakage_note: Document IDs parsed from '<doc_id>_<crop_id>' naming. However, because some document IDs span across classes with heavy class imbalance (especially Mixed with only 126 samples across few docs), sample-level stratified splitting with strict deduplication was applied to preserve the 4-class distribution in val/test. Document-level leakage prevention cannot be fully guaranteed from available metadata.
